fieldData.meta-title: Potluck Sign Up Sheet Builder With Dish Slots | Emergent
fieldData.meta-description: Build a potluck sign up sheet with dish slots that close when full, allergen tags, and reminder emails, saved to a database you own. Free to start.
fieldData.description: Build a potluck sign up sheet that caps each course and emails every cook a reminder of their dish before the event.
fieldData.explore-cta: Build My Potluck Sign Up Sheet
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-sub-heading: A potluck sign up sheet lists who brings which dish. These six parts keep every course covered and every cook reminded.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { officePotlucks: "Build a potluck sign up sheet for my office Thanksgiving lunch. Split it into 4 mains, 6 sides, 4 desserts, and 2 drinks, and ask for name and dish. Close a course once its slots are full; the next coworker should only see the courses that still need a dish. Show me a table of every sign-up by course.", churchDinners: "Build a sign up sheet for my church's Christmas dinner. Ask each cook for their name, the dish, and whether it contains tree nuts, dairy, eggs, or gluten. Email our kitchen lead, Mirela Dobrescu, one list of every dish with tree nuts. She sets those dishes on a separate table.", blockParties: "Build a potluck sign up sheet for my street's Halloween block party. Ask each household for its name, address, and dish. At 6 pm the evening before the party, email every household that signed up with its dish and the 5:30 pm drop-off time. Show me how many households have signed up.", familyReunions: "Build a sign up sheet for my family reunion of 62 relatives. Ask each household for its headcount, its dish, the course, and how many people the dish feeds. Add up servings by course, and email me when any course feeds fewer people than the headcount, with how many servings it is short." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-description: Seven steps to make a potluck sign up sheet that covers every course and reminds every cook, then build it with Emergent.
